extraction: Kimi API Tool Calling: OpenAI-compatible function calling format. Tools defined in messages array with type: 'function', function: {name, description, parameters}. Kimi intelligently selects and outputs JSON with function_call arguments. Example: model 'kimi-k3', user prompt 'Determine if 3214567 is prime', tools array with CodeRunner (python/javascript execution). Built-in tools: CodeRunner, Web Search. Supports parallel tool calls. Tool results returned to model for continued reasoning. Documentation index at platform.kimi.ai/docs/llms.txt.
